But this is far from a simple clone. Its circuit has been re-engineered with specific enhancements to deliver a sound rich in midrange , without the muddy low-end rumble , and with exceptional clarity. The Custom Muff is a bold reinterpretation of a classic, designed to cut through the mix in any band and under any playing conditions. It’s built to stand out , not get lost. This is a true rock tone machine , perfectly suited to both humbuckers and single coils. It offers massive gain levels paired with high-definition detail . In solos, the Custom Muff produces a rich, cutting tone that slices through the mix with ease. When playing chords or power chords, it delivers towering walls of sound . Whether in front of a tube amp or a solid-state setup, the experience is unforgettable. Despite the impressive gain, the pedal stays surprisingly quiet , thanks to a carefully crafted design, premium component selection —especially the transistors—and smart circuit refinements. + Detail - Detail The Tone control is built around a balancing circuit that allows you to dial in the perfect sound for every situation. The silicon diode clipping ensures a gritty, aggressive, and articulate distortion.
